tasks.title: Author the ship-checklist contract and validator
tasks.description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/ship-checklist.schema.json as a flat markdown-frontmatter schema (required: schema_version const 1.0, project, shipped_at date-time, review_decision const approved, reviewed_at date-time; additionalProperties true, like review-report.schema.json). Add validateShipChecklist(frontmatter, root) to cli/lib/validate.js using validateMarkdownArtifact, export it, import + re-export it in cli/appbuilder.js, and append 'ship-checklist' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first: validateShipChecklist unit tests (valid frontmatter passes; bad review_decision and missing required fields fail).
acceptance_criteria: ship-checklist.schema.json validates flat frontmatter with review_decision const approved and the required date-time fields.
validateShipChecklist is exported from cli/lib/validate.js and re-exported from cli/appbuilder.js.

tasks.title: Implement the ship verb (full-chain generator) and remove the placeholder group
tasks.description: Add cli/lib/ship.js exporting ship(cwd, args): `ship <slug>` collects failures and gates on build/<slug>/scaffold-report.json + build-report.json + test-report.json (all present and parsing) AND build/<slug>/review-report.md present with valid frontmatter and decision == approved. On any failure it prints `fail ship:` lines, exits 1, and writes nothing. On success it reads the reports and writes build/<slug>/ship-checklist.md: flat frontmatter (schema_version 1.0, project, shipped_at now ISO, review_decision approved, reviewed_at carried from review-report) plus ## Phase Summary (with test counts from test-report.json), ## Artifacts (built-file union from build-report.json plus the upstream reports), and ## Manual Go-Live Steps (static checkboxes). The generated frontmatter must pass validateShipChecklist before writing; ship refuses to overwrite an existing ship-checklist.md without --force. Replace the placeholder `case "ship"` in cli/appbuilder.js with `return ship(cwd, args)`, add a 'Ship commands:' help block, and remove the now-empty 'Later-phase workflow placeholders' group. Test-first: happy path (scaffold->build->test->review approved -> ship writes a valid checklist with correct counts); reds (missing each of scaffold/build/test report, decision changes_requested -> fail ship, exit 1, no file); --force (second run without --force refuses, with --force regenerates).
acceptance_criteria: `appbuilder ship <slug>` writes a schema-valid build/<slug>/ship-checklist.md only when scaffold/build/test reports exist and review-report.md decision == approved.
On any chain failure ship prints `fail ship:` lines, exits non-zero, and writes nothing; without --force it refuses to overwrite an existing checklist.
ship is routed as its own command with help text; the 'Later-phase workflow placeholders' group is removed.

tasks.title: Document the ship phase
tasks.description: Add a Ship section to README.md (the single verb, what the full-chain gate checks, the generated checklist, link to HOWTO) and a thorough ship-phase walkthrough to HOWTO.md after the Review section (the single verb, the full-chain gate rules, the generated checklist content, --force, a failure-mode -> fix table), renumbering the subsequent sections. Update README/HOWTO wording so the loop is described as placeholder-free (no remaining ship placeholder). Docs only.
acceptance_criteria: HOWTO.md has a thorough ship-phase walkthrough with the full-chain gate rules and a failure-mode table; later sections renumbered.
README.md has a Ship section; the placeholder wording is gone (loop described as complete).
doctor stays green (no broken plan-interview/onboarding references).
